Maya: Wild news 1010 we crossed 200M tokens/day on hosted today!!! :rocket: :tada:
Sam: WHAT. that's insane. congrats everyone :partying_face: :confetti_ball:
Rowan: omg the traffic graphs look like a mountain. will someone gif it for the #metrics-dashboard? :mountain:
Priya: I made a tiny poll  who wants a limited-edition '200M' enamel pin? react with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:
deploy-bot: milestone_event recorded  metric=tokens_per_day value=200000000 window=24h
Lila: i'll take a pin AND a commemorative sticker sheet pls. also cupcakes? low sugar option pls. :cupcake:
Marcus: can we ring the mini-bell in the lobby? i volunteer to do the ceremonial two-tone ring :bell:
Maya: lobby bell + virtual confetti at 3pm. @here quick 10-min sync for shoutouts and a silly screenshot of everyone's desk setups :camera: 
Sam: i'll photoshop a tiny mountain peak on the infra dashboard screenshot. very on brand :sunglasses:
Rowan: also shoutout to oncall last night who kept the KV cache healthy. you legends. :pray:
Priya: done with the poll  32 yes, 3 no, 5 undecided. pins it is. ordering now.
Lila: ordering logistics: office folks - pick up in kitchen; remote folks - we'll ship via slack form (link).
Marcus: i'll bring confetti poppers. heads up to custodial: small cleanup afterwards. :sweat_smile:
Maya: thank you team. tiny victory rituals mean a lot. see y'all 3pm (IRL & Zoom) :star-struck:
